questions.label: Iron Bowl
questions.prompt: Under Nick Saban (2007–2023), what was Alabama's record against Auburn teams that finished the season with 9 or more wins?
questions.reveal: 0–5. Auburn won all five: 2007 (finished 9–4), 2010 (14–0), 2013 (12–2), 2017 (10–4) and 2019 (9–4). Against every other Auburn team, Saban's Alabama went 12–0.

years.prompt: Name the five seasons Auburn beat Saban's Alabama with a 9-win team.

questions.label: Ranked Wins
questions.prompt: Since 2020, which school has more wins over AP-ranked opponents, and how many?
questions.reveal: Alabama 28, Auburn 4 (through 2025). Latest: Alabama: 2025 vs. No. 14 Missouri 27–24, 2025 vs. No. 11 Tennessee 37–20, 2025 vs. No. 8 Oklahoma 34–24; Auburn: 2021 vs. No. 17 Arkansas 38–23, 2021 vs. No. 10 Ole Miss 31–20, 2024 vs. No. 15 Texas A&M 43–41.

info.title: What counts as a ranked win?
info.text: A win over a team in the AP Top 25 the week of the game (bowls use the last regular-season poll), regular season and postseason, through 2025.

questions.label: Iron Bowl
questions.prompt: The 2014 Iron Bowl went to No. 2 Alabama, 55–44, over No. 15 Auburn. Which team gained more total yards, and by how much?
questions.reveal: 🔄 Twist: Auburn out-gained Alabama 630 to 539 (456 passing, 174 rushing) and still lost. Alabama also turned it over more, 3 to 2, and won anyway.

questions.label: Iron Bowl
questions.prompt: Who had more carries: Tre Mason in the 2013 SEC Championship Game (vs. Missouri) or Derrick Henry in the 2015 Iron Bowl?
questions.reveal: Same number: 46 each. Mason ran 46 times for 304 yards and 4 touchdowns in Auburn's 59–42 SEC title win over Missouri. Henry ran 46 times for 271 yards and a touchdown in Alabama's 29–13 Iron Bowl win.
